primary_failure_mode_caught: Platform hardening controls are applied to the wrong product, image layer, or evidence mode.

assumptions.posture: Assess OS images, container images, Kubernetes manifests, and system software configuration only where evidence supports applicability.
assumptions.runtime_boundary: Dockerfile, built image, host OS, daemon runtime, and cluster live state are separate evidence modes.

required_inputs: DISA STIG/SRG, NSA/CISA, or scanner-backed hardening references
must_not: apply a host STIG directly to a minimal container image without applicability evidence
treat package presence as configuration proof
infer final built-image state from Dockerfile text alone
claim runtime daemon posture without runtime, image, or config evidence
